parameters.content:
## Stopped emails
### How it works
When an LLM's free daily quota is used up (vision, classifier, invoice extractor or contact fill), the inbox organizer holds the email back instead of filing it half done, and writes one row per email to the n8n data table `stopped_emails`. This workflow is the other side of that list, behind one trigger with two callers.

The 7 AM briefing calls it as the `inbox` plugin: while rows remain, it puts one alert in NEEDS ATTENTION naming the first emails; on a quiet day it says nothing.

`/rerun_attachments` (or the Rerun button on the stop message) arrives through menu-handler: the vision block is cleared, every held-back email runs through the organizer again, 45 s apart, and each email that is filed takes its own row off the list. An email whose quota is still used up is stopped again, without a new message, and stays listed. The reply says how many were filed and how many are still waiting.

### Setup steps
1. Create the data tables `stopped_emails` and `vision_quota` (columns in the node notes) and put their ids in the data table nodes here, in the organizer and in any-file2json-converter.
2. Put the organizer's workflow id in Rerun Each Email.
3. Register this workflow in menu-handler's Config (`rerun_attachments`) and in the briefing's Plugins (`inbox`), then activate it.

nodes.name: When Called by Briefing or Menu
Clear Vision Block
nodes.notes: Empties vision_quota (written by any-file2json-converter) so a changed key is tried at once. If the quota is still used up, the first image is refused (costs nothing) and the block is written again.

nodes.name: Rerun Each Email
nodes.notes: Calls 04_inbox-attachment-organizer once per email, 45 s apart. Inputs: none set, the item {id} is passed through to its catch-up entry. A filed email clears its own row; a failed one alerts from its own run.

parameters.content:
## Rerun on request
Clears the vision block, runs every held-back email again 45 s apart, replies with what is still waiting.

nodes.name: Pause Between Emails
nodes.notes: 45 s before every email but the first, so the reruns' LLM calls stay under the per-minute limits. Under 65 s, so n8n keeps the run in memory.
